about: Register for this runtime's clerk and path-stack. Not inside scribe. English explanations are for Python and for any English reader. Dango is not fed this file. L1 is Japanese, then gloss, then L2 hyphenated @act/@path. Python uses this list to accept, refuse, and name seats.

act.meaning: What this block DOES. A verb phrase, hyphenated. Not a category. Strip the verb: if a tidy noun remains, the verb was decoration.

path.meaning: What it reaches toward. Direction word plus at least two real words (toward-… / away-from-…). not-yet-discerned = I have not looked. ruled-none = I looked and there is none.

aspect.meaning: How ripe it is. manifesting = becoming. manifested = settled. prospective = promised, not yet — the pod.

origin.meaning: Which kind of mind made the body. Not who vouches (that is attests).

because.meaning: Why a block overrules another. Closed four. Pair with overrules.

kept.meaning: Why something unused is still here. A museum label.

source.meaning: Whose saying this is (citation of a fixed past). Any spelling, keep it consistent.

attests.meaning: Who vouches, which may not be who wrote it. origin:ai attests:self = the AI wrote it, I stand behind it.

touched.meaning: A mind that passed through lightly, not the owner. Used here for executor, dango, proxy, shape, schnee, grok.

captured.meaning: Where-and-when the text arrived (a session, a thread). Historical, unlike source.

quoting.meaning: A pin so a citation cannot rot quietly. sha256:… or file:lines.

formed.meaning: When this saying came to be (a date).

amended.meaning: When a later layer was added (a date).

reviewed.meaning: A human claim: I read this since that version or date and acted. A machine must not write this as if it had read.

ref.meaning: This block reaches to that block (id or 辻…#id). Presence is belonging; a reference is salience.

overrules.meaning: This block sets that one aside. Always pair with because.

superseded.meaning: Put on the OLD block, pointing at what replaced it. Never only on the new one.

yields.meaning: If these two ever contradict, that one wins. Decided while calm.

replaces.meaning: A rewrite of that block, kept as a separate change.

awaits.meaning: The encounter that would prove this. A call-me-when note. Discloses. Never auto-promotes.

dissolves.meaning: The condition that would make this obsolete. A throw-me-away-when note.

verified.meaning: After the fact: what actually confirmed a prospective. Written at the close, not at birth.

defines.meaning: This is where that word was born. Only a human knows. Not a machine count of mentions.

rejected.meaning: The road considered and not taken. Stops the dead idea returning as if new.

continues.meaning: This block is another chapter of that whole, not a new thing.

reads.meaning: after-#id — the order a human should read, which is not arrival order.

customizes.meaning: A small local adaptation of that block, declared as such.

refuses.meaning: A capability deliberately left out, so nobody assumes it was never considered.

carries.meaning: What would fall without this block. Load-bearing, not decoration.

hoisted.meaning: from-#id — this used to be squeezed inside that block and needed its own space.

part.meaning: Which derived artifact this block belongs to (guide, walk, on-path…). Lets export pull one audience.

enables.meaning: What someone else must be able to DO because of this block. A verb they can perform.

preserves.meaning: What this change deliberately left alone. The anti-over-reading guard.

gates.meaning: The irreversible act this block is withholding.

forecloses.meaning: The retreat this block ends. Past here there is no backing out.

defers.meaning: Whose judgment this is, even though you technically could act.

watches.meaning: An outside path or file this block is keeping an eye on. Often with quoting:sha256.

name.meaning: A say-again label. scribe recall finds the newest block that carries it.

topic.meaning: A descriptive grouping word. Dead only if it is the only meaning-carrier (no act/path).

breaches.meaning: A rule this block knowingly broke. A confession kept, not a bug report.

tightens.meaning: This change made a requirement stricter.

reverts.meaning: This undid an earlier change. The earlier one still stands in the history.

renames.meaning: You retired a key; this records the old spelling.

relied.meaning: retrieval-head attention mass on a placed span, measured by the server hook; a reading, not a faithfulness claim

dialed.meaning: human-set contrastive force toward a placed span; a throttle, not a reading

pressed.meaning: human-set attention bias on a placed span; a throttle, not a reading
